correctness_validations.doi_format: Manual inspection: component release DOIs use plausible 10.18130/V3/... syntax, and linked preprints use plausible 10.1101/... syntax. No root doi is present. Registration and resolution were not externally checked.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: Manual inspection: 1OT2OD032742-01, 3OT2OD032742-01S2, and 5U54HG012513-02 have plausible NIH identifier structures and match the stated funder.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: The root identifier is a URI, not an RRID. RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 occur as source cell-line references; they are not treated as root dataset SCR/AB identifiers.
correctness_validations.url_validity: Manual inspection: cited HTTPS URLs have plausible structures and domains. Reachability and target contents were not checked.
correctness_validations.validation_scope: Assessment used only the supplied record and rubric. No commands, browsing, external-file reads, or tool-based validation were performed.

issues_detected.description: The root lists component releases but provides neither parent-dataset links nor typed related-dataset relationships.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document supported parent and related-dataset relationships with explicit relationship types, keeping each release's identity distinct.

issues_detected.description: Variable-level metadata is missing, and the record does not specify tabular status or split/subpopulation flags for its subsets.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide variable identifiers and definitions, units or value conventions where relevant, and explicit dataset-structure flags with their meanings.

issues_detected.description: Ethical-review entries contain contacts rather than review findings, waivers, or oversight determinations, and no downstream social-impact analysis is documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document any applicable oversight decision or review and its scope, and describe anticipated downstream impacts and mitigations. Distinguish contacts from completed reviews.

issues_detected.description: The record claims deidentified status and explains its commercial cell-line rationale, but does not document a specific deidentification or determination method.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the documented method or determination underlying the deidentified status and its limitations; do not invent identifier-removal steps.

issues_detected.description: The general unlinkability assertion is not accompanied by an explicit re-identification risk assessment or privacy-protection account.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the relevant privacy assessment, its assumptions, and applicable protections or limitations.

issues_detected.description: Consent procedures, scope, withdrawal provisions, or an applicable consent waiver are not documented. Unknown caller applicability keeps this item scored.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record available source consent or waiver information and its scope, without inferring consent from commercial availability.

issues_detected.description: The record contains no at-risk population safeguards or compensation documentation. This is not a finding of ethical noncompliance.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the relevant safeguards and compensation status, including explicit supported statements when these concepts do not apply.

issues_detected.description: Incomplete modality overlap is acknowledged, but sampling procedures, missing-data patterns and handling, and measurement anomalies or quality findings are not documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe assay-specific quality findings, sampling or selection procedures, missingness patterns, and handling strategies; distinguish source-document discrepancies from data anomalies.

issues_detected.description: The evaluated root has no version number; component release versions do not establish a version for the dataset series.
issues_detected.recommendation: If a root-series version exists, document it explicitly and distinguish it from component release versions.

issues_detected.description: The root updates entry states a schedule but does not describe completed changes or errata.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a root-level account of release-series changes and applicable errata with clear references to affected releases.

issues_detected.description: The preprocessing entry describes release packaging and provenance metadata. FAIRSCAPE is not documented as transforming the measurements, and no actual measurement-processing workflow or processing software is named.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the transformations applied to each released modality and name the software that performed them. Keep packaging and metadata tooling separately identified.

issues_detected.description: No sensitive-content assessment or content-warning statement is supplied.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a supported sensitive-content assessment and any relevant warnings, or explicitly document that none were identified.

issues_detected.description: The root lacks both a recommended citation and a DOI. Child-release citations and the latest-release DOI remain component-specific evidence.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide an appropriate citation for the root dataset series, or a series DOI if one exists, while retaining release-specific citations at their actual locations.
